reason: Ear origin defines otologic disease; the broader head and neck parent does not establish gastrointestinal or pulmonary involvement.
Disordered bone mineralization defines musculoskeletal and metabolic_endocrine disease. Chronic kidney disease is the separately diagnosed underlying cause, not renal damage caused by osteodystrophy.

Neurologic, ocular and skeletal abnormalities define CODAS. Dental defects support gastrointestinal involvement at 80-99%; the four-axis cap reasonably excludes less frequent hearing loss and vocal cord paresis.
Developmental impairment, cardiac malformations/cardiomyopathy and thumb abnormalities support the three primary axes. Pigment changes alone do not establish additional damaging skin involvement.
A plasma-related defect of phagocytosis supports infectious_immune. The evidence does not establish an intrinsic blood-cell disorder requiring haematologic labeling.
Auditory canal atresia and vertical talus define otologic and musculoskeletal disease. Hypertelorism does not establish ocular damage; the broad parent does not require pulmonary labeling.
Autoimmune skin sclerosis defines the umbrella. Musculoskeletal damage is not obligatory, and visceral involvement is not established above the threshold across localized and systemic forms.
The eyelid is explicitly assigned to ocular. Skin-related ancestry does not require an additional dermatologic label for this anatomically defined eyelid neoplasm.

Neurodevelopmental abnormalities, skeletal malformations and persistent mosaic skin changes define the syndrome. Heart failure and pulmonary arterial hypertension at 80-99% support cardiovascular involvement.

Neuromuscular-junction dysfunction and contractures support neurologic and musculoskeletal axes. Cleft palate in 1/2 supports gastrointestinal involvement; respiratory weakness alone does not establish pulmonary damage.
